stories.title: Chester Haematology Centre to open at Countess of Chester Hospital in late July
stories.summary: A new dedicated centre for blood cancer patients is due to open at the Countess of Chester Hospital in late July, with north Wales patients among those who will use it. stories.title: Young footballers in Flintshire could land brand new kit thanks to Euro tournament giveaway
stories.summary: Young footballers in Flintshire could score a brand-new kit this summer thanks to a competition linked to a major international competition. stories.title: Jade Jones Pavilion launches free monthly coffee morning open to all in Flint
stories.summary: A monthly coffee morning is launching at Jade Jones Pavilion in Flint next week, open to anyone who wants to come in for a chat with no booking needed. stories.title: Welsh skills rising among Flintshire council staff as annual language report published
stories.summary: The share of Flintshire County Council staff who say they have no Welsh skills has fallen from 33.1 per cent to 28.7 per cent in a year, according to the council’s annual Welsh language report. stories.title: Welsh Government announces £145 million for NHS Wales to cut waiting times
stories.summary: The Welsh Government has announced £145 million in extra funding for NHS Wales this financial year, with reducing waiting times named as the immediate priority.
